title: Identifying molecular signatures underpinning treatment responses to novel therapeutics influencing COVID-19 outcomes.
snippet: COVID-19 continues to present ongoing global health challenges driven by diverse immune responses and heterogeneous clinical outcomes. The ACCORD trial evaluated 3 investigational treatments-bemcentinib, tozorakimab, and zilucoplan-in patients hospitalized with COVID-19, each of which has demonstrated clinical efficacy.
